summary: Carter's, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing under Item 8.01 that its limited duration stockholder rights agreement, dated September 22, 2025, with Equiniti Trust Company, LLC, expired by its own terms. The associated preferred stock purchase rights are no longer exercisable and the agreement is no longer in effect. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, or transaction terms are stated. This is a poison-pill lapse, not a standalone special situation; whether an activist accumulates stock now that the pill has lapsed is the item to watch.
